999008199.text:
わあ、なんだろうこの植物？
このキノコも見たことない！

localizations.en: Wow, what kind of plant is this? And I've never seen mushrooms like these before!

999008199.text:
はー、この島に来てよかった。
どこもかしこも珍しいものばかり

localizations.en: I'm so glad we came to this island. Everything here is completely new!

999008199.text: 未開の地の探索！　これこそ冒険だよねー！

localizations.en: Exploring uncharted territory! Now THIS is what I call an adventure!

999008199.text:
よくそんなにはしゃぎ回れるわね。
いつもの探索と変わらないじゃない

localizations.en: How can you get so excited about this? It's no different from our usual expeditions.

999008199.text: そうね。どれも同じ草に見えるけど。何が違うの？

localizations.en: Right. All these plants look the same to me. What's so different about them?

999008199.text:
ぜんぜん違うよ！　こっちの葉っぱは丸いし
こっちは棘があるし……

localizations.en: They're totally different! These leaves are round, and these ones have thorns...

999008199.text:
効能は……見ただけじゃ分かんないけど。
錬金術の素材になりそうなものばかりだよ

localizations.en: As for their properties... well, I can't tell just by looking. But they all seem perfect for alchemy!

999008199.text: あー、色々試したくなってきたー！

localizations.en: Oooh, I can't wait to try them all out!

999008199.text:
はあ、どうして錬金術士って
素材を前にするとみんな子どもっぽくなるのかしら

localizations.en: *sigh* Why do all alchemists turn into little kids when they find new materials?

999008199.text: 好奇心の塊というか……無邪気すぎるのよね

localizations.en: They're like bundles of curiosity... Almost too innocent for their own good.

999008199.text:
そんなことないと思うけどなあ。
二人だって……あ！

localizations.en: I don't think that's true at all. You two would... Oh!

999008199.text:
ねえねえ、二人とも。
見てほしいものがあるんだけど

localizations.en: Hey hey, you two! There's something I want to show you!

999008199.text: なによ？
じゃーん！！
ひっ……きゃああああ！！
な、ななな、何よそれ！

localizations.en: W-w-what in the world is that?!

999008199.text:
なんだろう。あたしも分かんない。
でも、変わった生き物だよねー

localizations.en: No idea! I'm not sure either. But it's such a weird little creature!

999008199.text:
それ、触っても大丈夫なの？
っていうか、よく触れたわね！？

localizations.en: Are you sure it's safe to touch that? More importantly, how could you even bring yourself to touch it?!

999008199.text:
あはは、大丈夫だよ。
人間が近づいても逃げなかったし

localizations.en: Haha, it's fine! It didn't run away when I got close...

999008199.text:
もしかしたら、ランターナイルカみたいに
人間が好きかも……あ、噛まれた

localizations.en: Maybe it's friendly like the Lantarna dolphins... Ouch, it bit me.

999008199.text: な、なにやってるのよ！　治療しなさい、治療！

localizations.en: W-what are you doing?! Get some medicine on that, now!

999008199.text: 好奇心旺盛にもほどがあるわよ、ライザ！

localizations.en: There's such a thing as too much curiosity, Ryza!

999008199.text: ライザ先輩たち、すごく楽しそうですね

localizations.en: Miss Ryza and the others look like they're having so much fun!

999008199.text:
うん、ミミちゃんが
あんなにはしゃいでるのって珍しいかも

localizations.en: Yeah, it's rare to see Mimi getting this excited about anything.

999008199.text: それ、早くどうにかしなさいよ！

localizations.en: Would you do something about that thing already?!

999008199.text:
じゃあ、ウィルベル。
ちょっと持っててくれる？

localizations.en: Hey Wilbell, wanna hold it for a sec?

999008199.text: 嫌に決まってるでしょ！！

ふふっ。
なんだか子どもみたいで可愛いよね

localizations.en: Hehe. They're all acting like little kids. It's kind of cute!

999008199.text: ふふっ、そうですね！
